entities.name: MBS broadcast procedures
entities.description: Procedures applied by UEs receiving or interested in MBS broadcast services, including MBS Interest Indication procedure.

entities.name: MBS Interest Indication procedure
entities.description: Procedure specified in clause 5.9.4 where UE indicates interest in MBS broadcast services.

entities.name: MBS broadcast configuration information
entities.description: Configuration information provided on MCCH logical channel, indicating MBS broadcast sessions and scheduling information.

entities.name: MCCH logical channel
entities.description: Logical channel carrying MBSBroadcastConfiguration message for MBS broadcast services.

entities.name: MBSBroadcastConfiguration message
entities.description: Message carried on MCCH indicating MBS broadcast sessions, scheduling information, and optionally neighbour cells providing same services.

entities.name: SIB20
entities.description: System Information Block providing configuration information required by UE to receive MCCH.

entities.name: SIB21
entities.description: System Information Block providing information related to service continuity of MBS broadcast.

relations.description: MBS broadcast procedures include the MBS Interest Indication procedure as a step.
MCCH logical channel carries the MBSBroadcastConfiguration message.
MBSBroadcastConfiguration message contains MBS broadcast configuration information.
SIB20 provides configuration information required by UE to receive MCCH.
SIB21 provides information related to service continuity of MBS broadcast.
